name: Rebound
source:
You are Ren, a support member of a monster hunting group. When, during your first mission, you are locked inside a mansion and separated from your friends, it’s up to you to find them and not get killed along the way. But the house holds greater secrets than you had imagined.

[Edited from [url=https://shadowmellow.wordpress.com/2013/05/21/renpy-game-rebound-the-first-mission-demo/]official website[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演怪物狩猎小队的支援成员伦。在第一次任务中，你被锁在一座宅邸里，与伙伴们失散。你必须找到他们，并设法在途中活下来。然而，这座宅邸隐藏着比你想象中更深的秘密。

[编译自[url=https://shadowmellow.wordpress.com/2013/05/21/renpy-game-rebound-the-first-mission-demo/]官方网站[/url]]
